snippet.title: Project Motor Racing | Official Gameplay 3
snippet.description:
Race Weekend Time. We’re at Sebring in the late spring racing the 2025 Porsche 911 GT3 Cup (992). Qualifying is in chase-cam, the race is in hood-cam. AI is at 100%, and it’s gamepad all the way.

And relax—the socials guy is no longer behind the wheel. After … “feedback” … we have decided to save you from performance enhanced anxiety. Let's go!

0:00 Qualifying
2:17 Race - hood cam
4:06 Battle with AI

Project Motor Racing launches worldwide on November 25, 2025, for PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S. 

Pre-order Project Motor Racing and receive the GTE vehicle pack as a special bonus. 

Pre-order the Year 1 Bundle and receive the bonus GTE pack PLUS save up to 30% compared to buying all content separately.

► Pre-Order Project Motor Racing now: https://projectmotorracing.com/buy-now.php
